title: E-FRC-0196: the Yukawa test for two color singlets (stand-ins for nucleons) of the paid-string rule on the D4 box...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0196 in the gauge arena: the Yukawa test for two color singlets (stand-ins for nucleons) of the paid-string rule on the D4 box: the meson profile and the residual between compact singlets, fitted on the husk and in the bulk, against the prediction that the residual carries twice the meson mass.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
